overview.heading: What is on Wetherspoons fish dishes?
overview.body:
The fish dishes section covers battered cod, breaded scampi and several seafood alternatives in different meal formats. [Freshly Battered Cod and Chips](/fish-dishes/battered-cod-chips) is the traditional fish supper choice, with a large cod fillet in crisp batter. [Whitby Breaded Scampi](/fish-dishes/whitby-breaded-scampi) uses whole-tail scampi with a breadcrumb coating instead. That distinction matters if your preference is for a single fillet rather than separate breaded pieces.

[Tuna Mayo Jacket Potato](/fish-dishes/tuna-mayo-jacket-potato) offers a baked potato filled with tuna and mayonnaise, while Fish Finger Sandwich puts breaded cod fish fingers between white or malted bread. Prawn Cocktail is described as a starter, with coldwater prawns and Marie Rose sauce. These are not interchangeable meals: decide first whether you want a fish supper, a potato-based lunch, a sandwich or a starter.

overview.heading: Does Wetherspoons do small fish and chips?
overview.body:
Small Battered Cod and Chips is the smaller fish and chips option in this selection. Its description specifies a smaller cod fillet with the same battered format, making it the clearest alternative when the larger Freshly Battered Cod and Chips sounds more than you want. Choosing it is about portion size, not a confirmed calorie saving or a known difference in price.

Small Whitby Breaded Scampi provides another smaller-format choice and is described with chips and garden peas. Compare that with the larger Whitby Breaded Scampi before ordering, particularly if accompaniments matter to you. The available description does not establish every side for the larger dish. A smaller meal can suit a modest appetite, but check the local price difference rather than assuming smaller automatically means better value.

overview.heading: Are Wetherspoons fish dishes seasonal?
overview.body:
No seasonal or rotating fish dish is identified in this selection. The named choices are cod and chips, scampi, their smaller versions, Tuna Mayo Jacket Potato, Fish Finger Sandwich and Prawn Cocktail. Fish Friday is a weekly special, not evidence that a different seafood dish appears each week. Avoid planning a visit around an unconfirmed seasonal addition.

The practical check is your chosen pub's current menu, especially if you are travelling specifically for one dish. Ask about any locally listed alternative rather than assuming it is part of the wider selection. If your first choice is unavailable, choose a substitute by format: small cod for a smaller fish supper, breaded scampi for a different coating and seafood choice, or the tuna jacket potato for a potato-based meal.
